title: Officer cleared in shooting death
article: Ontario's oversight body for police forces has cleared a female Waterloo Regional Police officer of criminal wrongdoing in the shooting death of 26-year-old Trevor Colin Graham.
Graham was shot in November by an officer who was responding to a robbery at a drugstore in Kitchener, Ont.
Special Investigations Unit director James Cornish said the officer was "clearly acting within the course of her lawful duties when she... confronted Graham." The officer was not named.
